meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先访谈你在做什么工作,据此帮你定制 claude-mem 的记录模式:提出观察类型和概念标签,安装并激活,重启 worker,再验证启动上下文里出现该模式。Telegram 提醒可选。
howto.when: 当你要求定制 claude-mem 记录什么、创建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等时触发,即使你不说「mode」这个词。

say.text: 帮我定制一个记录法律案件要点的模式
say.note: Claude 会先问你在做什么工作

say.text: 给这个模式加 Telegram 提醒,只推送关键结论
say.note: 会先让你确认类型和标签再配置

say.text: 把标准 code 模式改成跟踪实验结论的变体
say.note: 安装前需你确认分类方案

howto.what_en: After install, Claude interviews you about your work and builds a custom claude-mem mode: it proposes observation types and concept tags, installs and activates it, restarts the worker, and verifies the mode shows up in startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or set Telegram alerts for certain memories, even without saying "mode".

say_en.text: Customize a mode that records key points from legal cases
say_en.note: Claude first asks what you're working on

say_en.text: Add a Telegram alert to this mode for key findings only
say_en.note: It confirms types and tags before setup

say_en.text: Turn the standard code mode into a variant that tracks experiment results
say_en.note: You approve the taxonomy before install
